related.title: 即時編譯與程式最佳化
related.why: IR、支配與語義驗證可直接沿用
related.whyEn: IR, dominance and semantic validation transfer
related.transfer: IR、支配與語義驗證可直接沿用
related.transferEn: IR, dominance and semantic validation transfer
related.difference: JIT 另需執行時金鑰、守衛與程式碼生命週期
related.differenceEn: JIT also needs runtime symbols, guards and code lifetimes
practice: 由「詞法契約」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「JIT 另需執行時金鑰、守衛與程式碼生命週期」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From lexer contract, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "JIT also needs runtime symbols, guards and code lifetimes", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.

history.title: 語言與剖析
history.text: 官方公開資料「LLVM 詞法與前端教學」提供架構脈絡；本課先由「詞法契約」及「保留字」建立邊界，再進入實驗判讀。這是原創教材的學習順序，不是宣稱技術發明年代。
history.textEn: The primary reference LLVM lexer and frontend tutorial supplies architectural context. These original lessons start with lexer contract and keywords before experiments; this is a learning sequence, not an invention-date claim.
